veranderings.blok: Die vuur maak sy eie hitte
veranderings.voor: die vuurhoutjie heeltyd by te hou
veranderings.na: die vuurhoutjie heeltyd by die hout te hou
veranderings.rede: 'bythou' reads as the separable verb 'byhou' (keep up with); naming what the match is held to makes the meaning clear without adding content.

veranderings.blok: Die vuur maak sy eie hitte
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017: comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb ('Water ... vat ... weg' and 'die vuur gaan dood'); the protected wording stays intact.

veranderings.voor: vat die hitte weg en 'n glas
veranderings.na: vat die hitte weg, en 'n glas
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017: comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
In the sense of reaching something, the idiom is 'by iets kom'; 'bykom' on its own means to regain consciousness.
A plug goes 'in' a wall socket; 'by' is the wrong preposition here.

veranderings.blok: Wat om te doen tydens 'n brand
veranderings.rede: The inverted condition can be read by a Grade 5 learner as the order 'burn your clothes'; an explicit 'as' clause keeps the same meaning and removes the misreading.

veranderings.blok: Wat om te doen tydens 'n brand
veranderings.rede: 'totdat' is the standard conjunction before a clause; 'tot' is a preposition.
